basic_details.short_information: Eastern Coalfields Limited (ECL), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is engaging one (01) full time Advisor (Geology) on contract basis, open only to retired E8 grade executives or equivalent from CIL and its subsidiaries, PSUs and Autonomous Organizations of Central / State Government. The application, with the prescribed format and documents, must reach the office of HOD(EE), ECL, Sanctoria by Registered Post / Speed Post, or be sent to [email protected], by 05:00 PM on 05 December 2026.

qualification.details: There is one post: Advisor (Geology), full time, on contractual basis. | Eligible applicants: retired E8 grade executive or equivalent, from CIL and its subsidiaries, PSUs / Autonomous Organizations of Central / State Government. Qualification: PG in Geology. Work experience: minimum 15 years of experience related to Geology. Preference: preference will be given to the candidate having sound technical knowledge and adequate experience in the Raniganj Coalfields. Age limit: above 60 and not more than 65 years during the contract period. Not eligible: VRS optees will not be considered. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. | Consolidated monthly compensation / honorarium is paid as per the equivalent grade of CIL. | Conveyance: the company shall provide conveyance as per availability; where it is not provided, the Advisor is eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charges. Accommodation: suitable company accommodation on availability; if not available, HRA as per the CIL HRA Rules for X, Y and Z class of cities, based on the DOE circular OM dated 07.07.2017. Mobile phone: reimbursement based on actual bills or ₹1000/- p.m., whichever is less. Medical: CIL executives covered under the post retiral benefits scheme continue under that scheme; appointees not on the roll of CIL get the same coverage if they are not covered under any post retiral benefit scheme. Leave: paid leave of 15 (fifteen) days in every six months spell, in addition to paid holidays, regulated as per CIL Executive Leave Rules; not encashable, and accumulated leave lapses on expiry of each period of engagement. TA / DA on official tour: as per entitlement on retirement, restricted to air travel by Economy class only. Joining and exit travel: cost of one ticket (for self) if travelling from out-station to join, and one ticket (for self) on expiry of contract. Hotel: as per entitlement at retirement / superannuation, limited to Single Room; DA as admissible at retirement if boarding and lodging is not provided. GST: where payment of GST is required, it is reimbursed on production of proof of payment.

selection_process: ECL reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the interview / selection process for the notified post. No T.A. will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the interview / selection process. The engagement is subject to medical fitness certified by the Company Medical Officer.
important_instructions: The contract period is initially one (01) year, which may be extended depending upon requirement and satisfactory performance. Notice period for termination: one month's notice or consolidated compensation amount from either side; otherwise the engagement ends automatically at the end of the period in the offer letter. The Advisor must join within 15 days of the offer of engagement (or in exceptional circumstances, as approved by the concerned Functional Director); otherwise the offer stands withdrawn. The Advisor gives proposals and advice in writing under signature, but will not supervise day to day work of employees nor certify or pass bills. The Advisor shall not accept any other full-time appointment, advisory or administrative, in any firm or company during the engagement. All information gathered must be kept in strict confidence, during and after the engagement. Rules of promotion on Vigilance / Departmental / Safety Clearances apply; other terms follow CIL's policy for engaging retired CMDs / Directors / Sr. Level Executives as Advisors. ECL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies and cancel / restrict / modify / alter the engagement process without notice. Any modification will be given on the ECL website only.

content_sections.heading: About ECL
content_sections.text: Eastern Coalfields Limited is a subsidiary of Coal India Limited (CIL). The application office named in the notice is at Sanctoria, P.S. Dishergarh, Burdwan, West Bengal. The Advisor (Geology) will be stationed at ECL HQ and will hand over all records at the end of the engagement to the HOD (Geology), ECL HQ.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application format can be downloaded from the ECL website www.easterncoalfields.in under the caption "Recruitment Notices". The same format is printed at the end of the notification. Candidates submit their resume and the application format with the self-attested documents listed under Enclosures. Fill in the application format for the post of Advisor (Geology) in Eastern Coalfields Limited (16 points, followed by a declaration, signature with date and list of enclosures). Attach your resume and the self-attested documents named in the notice. By post: send by Registered Post / Speed Post to the office of HOD(EE), ECL, Sanctoria, P.S. Dishergarh, Pin-713333, Burdwan (W.B). On the envelope, superscribe "Application for the post of Advisor (Geology), ECL". By email: send to [email protected] with the subject "Application for the post of Advisor (Geology), ECL". The application must reach within 15 days from the date of notification (including Sundays and holidays), that is, by 05:00 PM on 05 December 2026. Applications received by email or post after 05:00 PM on 05 December 2026 in the office of GM/HOD (HR/EE), ECL will not be considered. ECL will not be responsible for any postal delay or loss in transit.

content_sections.heading: ECL Advisor (Geology) Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide expert guidance - Geological domain. Oversee activities and advise for smooth functioning and effective implementation of activities related to Geology, Underground Coal Gasification, Geo-Technical related work, New Initiative, Mine Closure and Repurposing. Monitor the Geotechnical Lab & NABL Accreditation. Assist in formulating strategies for transparent and cost-effective process. Recommend best practices. Advise on policy frameworks. Capacity Building of the Department for being self-reliant in their respective domain. Any other jobs assigned as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Resume Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate) Superannuation notice Office order / Official Document / certification from the respective organization regarding Gratuity and Retiral Dues, etc. Certificates of qualification Experience Certificate with Promotion details throughout the career Certificate of Scale of Pay All documents must be self-attested. The application format also asks for EIS No. (if retired from CIL), caste, date of birth, experience details (whether worked for at least 15 years in Geology Department), employment details till superannuation, any pending Vigilance / Departmental / Safety / Court / Police case, and the Superannuation Notice No. & Date.

No T.A. will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the interview / selection process. The engagement is subject to medical fitness certified by the Company Medical Officer.
